sources.title: May 31 to June 1, 2013 tornado and flash flooding event
sources.use: The event account, path chronology, final EF3 rating, maximum reported width and damage photograph captions. Its narrative and summary table give different ending times; both remain visible in this exhibit.

sources.title: El Reno final tornado path file (KMZ download)
sources.use: The original outline, center path and 39 time-labeled positions used by the map. A whole-event outline does not describe the funnel shape at each minute.

sources.title: Storm Events 2013 data, record 453682 (CSV.gz download)
sources.use: The preserved March 23, 2026 revision supplies the event record and its direct fatality and injury figures. County-level source records are not necessarily distinct tornadoes.

sources.title: The Enhanced Fujita scale
sources.use: How surveyors use damage indicators and degrees of damage to estimate intensity. The rating alone cannot reconstruct the visible funnel.

sources.title: El Reno wedge photograph, May 31, 2013
sources.use: Original photograph, attribution and CC BY 2.0 reuse terms. Its historical filename retains an EF5 label; the final official damage rating is EF3. Exact time and viewpoint are not registered here.

sources.title: El Reno tornado photograph, May 31, 2013
sources.use: The second preserved photograph and its CC BY 2.0 attribution. This view has not been synchronized with the map.

sources.title: NOAA statement remembering three storm researchers
sources.use: Public identification of Tim Samaras, Paul Samaras and Carl Young. This supports their names in the remembrance section.

sources.title: Breakdown of the storm fatalities in Oklahoma
sources.use: Contemporary reporting used for named victims and context about regional hospital figures. Early ratings and conflicting ages are not carried into this exhibit.

sources.title: Dustin Bridges obituary
sources.use: Public obituary used to verify the name Dustin Heath Bridges. No portrait is reproduced.

sources.title: William O’Neal obituary
sources.use: Public obituary used alongside contemporary reporting for William O’Neal. No portrait is reproduced.

sources.title: Language barriers hinder storm warnings in Oklahoma
sources.use: Contemporary reporting used for Maria Pol Martin and Rey Chicoj Pol. This is a secondary account, separate from the official event totals.

sources.title: Locating and synchronizing storm imagery
sources.use: A conference abstract describing the registration of chaser imagery. It guides the proposed method; it does not establish that this exhibit has already registered its photographs or reconstructed the storm.

sources.title: Published NWRT phased-array radar animation
sources.use: Original animation for twelve time-linked regional reflectivity frames. Printed filename times are interpreted as UTC, as stated beside the timeline.

sources.title: Ground-based damage survey and radar analysis of the El Reno, Oklahoma Tornado (PDF)
sources.publisher: Timothy P. Marshall and colleagues, AMS conference paper, 2014
sources.use: Selected survey sections support the separate community evidence checks. Review coverage is recorded with those entries.
